**मुख्य नियम**
- धितो सुरक्षणको मोल घट्न गएमा बैंकले निश्चित म्याद दिई ऋणीलाई थप धितो सुरक्षण राख्न लगाउन सक्छ [3]।

**अर्को बाटो**
- बैंकको आफ्नै गुनासो सुनुवाई डेस्क र गुनासो सुन्ने अधिकारीलाई पहिले सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस्।
- समाधान नभए नेपाल राष्ट्र बैङ्कको गुनासो पोर्टलमार्फत उजुरी दिनुहोस्।
- अदालतमा देवानी दाबी गर्नु अर्को बाटो हो, जसका लागि वकिलको सल्लाह लिनुहोस्।

**स्रोतहरूले नसमेटेको कुरा**
- मैले पाएका स्रोतहरूले लिलाम प्रक्रिया अघि बैंकले दिनुपर्ने अन्तिम सूचनाको म्याद वा विवरण समेटेका छैनन्।

- तपाईंको कर्जा सम्झौतामा पेनाल ब्याजको दर कति छ?
- बैंकले लिलामको लागि कति दिन अगाडि सूचना दिएको छ?

यो सामान्य कानुनी जानकारी मात्र हो, इजाजतपत्रप्राप्त अधिवक्ताको सल्लाहको विकल्प होइन। जरुरी वा महत्वपूर्ण विषयमा कृपया वकिलसँग सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस्।

answers.question: My employer terminated me during probation without notice. Do I get any compensation?
answers.answer:
I understand how frustrating it is to face sudden termination during a probation period.

**Notice period rules**
- Under the Labour Act, 2074, Section 144(1)(a), in cases other than termination due to misconduct, prior notice of at least one day must be given for employment up to four weeks [1].
- Under the Labour Act, 2074, Section 144(2), if an employer terminates employment without giving notice, remuneration for the notice period must be provided to the concerned worker [1].

**Next steps**
- Request a written explanation for your dismissal if you do not have one.
- Gather your appointment letter, pay slips, and any written notice.

**What the sources don't cover**
- The sources retrieved do not cover specific statutory compensation for probation termination apart from notice period remuneration.

**It would help to know**
- How many weeks or months had you worked when terminated?
- Did your employer provide any written letter or state a reason for termination?

answers.question: What are the grounds for divorce in Nepal and who gets child custody?
answers.answer:
**Empathy**
I understand that navigating divorce and child custody decisions can be a very challenging and emotional process.

**Child Custody**
- Under the Muluki Civil Code, 2074, Section 115, if there is a separate agreement regarding taking custody of a minor at the time of divorce or separation between husband and wife, it shall be as agreed [1].
- According to Section 115, in making a decision regarding whether a minor who has completed ten years of age is to be kept in the custody of the father or mother, the opinion of the minor concerned may be taken [1].
- Under Section 116, if the income of the mother or father who does not take custody of the minor is higher than that of the mother or father who takes custody, such mother or father must provide expenses for the maintenance, education, and medical treatment of the minor as agreed upon or as determined by the court [2].

**Next Steps**
- Try to agree on custody, visits, and the child's expenses in writing first.
- If you cannot reach an agreement, consult an advocate about bringing these matters to the District Court.
- Keep records of who has been caring for the child and maintain a stable routine for them.

**It would help to know**
- Have you and your spouse made any written agreement regarding your child?
- How old is your child?
- Are you currently living separately from your spouse?

answers.answer:
I understand that managing ancestral property can lead to complex family disagreements.

**Partition requirement**
- Under the Muluki Civil Code, 2074, Section 216, a written deed of partition must be executed between coparceners when dividing common property [3].
- The law requires that the partition of common property and common debts must be done without any increase or decrease in shares [3].
- Partition must be carried out by matching good and bad quality assets according to the consent of the coparceners [3].

**Next steps**
- Try to negotiate an amicable partition with other coparceners first.
- Gather land ownership certificates and family lineage records showing you are a coparcener.
- If your share is denied, you may file a partition suit at the District Court with the help of an advocate.

- The sources retrieved do not cover whether an individual can sell their specific portion of ancestral property before a formal partition is registered.

**It would help to know**
- Has a formal partition deed already been registered at the Land Revenue Office?
- Are your brothers currently refusing to sign a partition deed?
- Is the property currently registered in your name or a common ancestor's name?

answers.question: A shop refuses to refund a defective product. What can I do?
answers.answer:
I understand how frustrating it is when a seller refuses to take responsibility for a defective product.

**Direct answer**
- Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2075, Section 14, you can receive another similar product of the same value or the amount paid while purchasing such product [1].

**Legal rules**
- You must show the bill or receipt provided by the seller at the time of purchase when returning the product [1].
- The product cannot be returned or exchanged if the purchaser has changed the quality or quantity of the product after purchase [1].
- Selling or providing goods by lying, hiding, or deceiving regarding the actual quality, quantity, price, weight, size, or structure is considered an unfair trade practice [3].

**Next steps**
- Contact the seller first with your bill and evidence to request a refund or replacement.
- If the issue remains unresolved, you may file a complaint with the Department of Commerce, Supplies and Consumer Protection or a local inspection officer.
- Keep photos of the defective product and any communication with the seller as evidence.

**It would help to know**
- Do you still have the original purchase receipt?
- Have you already attempted to contact the seller about the defect?
- Was the product purchased online or from a physical shop?

answers.question: Can I cancel a signed rental agreement before the term ends?
answers.answer:
I understand that your circumstances may have changed, making it necessary to consider ending your rental commitment early.

**Termination rules**
- Under the Muluki Civil Code, 2074, Section 400, a person who has taken a house on rent may leave the house before the expiry of the rental period if the house is no longer required for the purpose for which it was rented [2].
- The tenant may also leave the house before the term ends if the house owner fails to fulfill their obligations or acts contrary to the agreement or the law [2].

**Notice period**
- According to Section 400 (2), unless otherwise mentioned in the agreement, the person renting the house must provide at least thirty-five days' prior written notice to the house owner to leave the house [2].

**Next steps**
- Draft a formal written notice and ensure you have proof of delivery to the landlord.

**It would help to know**
- What is the reason for wanting to cancel the agreement?
- Is the monthly rent amount more or less than twenty thousand rupees?

- Under the Right to Information Act, 2064, Section 9, a person can file a complaint to the head of the public body within 7 days if the Information Officer refuses to provide information [2].

७. सूचना प्राप्त गर्नेकार्यविधि : (१) यस ऐन बमोजिम कुनै सूचना प्राप्त गर्नचाहने नेपाली
नागरिकले त्यस्तो सूचना प्राप्त गर्नुपर्नेकारण खुलाई सम्बन्धित सूचना अधिकारी समक्ष
निवेदन दिनु पर्नेछ ।
(२) उपदफा (१) बमोजिम निवेदन प्राप्त भएमा सूचना अधिकारीले तत्काल उपलब्ध
गराउन सकिने प्रकृतिको सूचना भए तत्काल र तत्काल उपलब्ध गराउन नसकिने प्रकृतिको
सूचना भए निवेदन प्राप्त भएको मितिले पन्ध्र दिनभित्र निवेदकलाई सूचना उपलब्ध गराउनु
पर्नेछ ।
(३) उपदफा (२) बमोजिम तत्काल सूचना उपलब्ध गराउन नसकिने भएमा सूचना
अधिकारीले सोको कारण सहितको जानकारी तुरुन्त निवेदकलाई गराउनु पर्नेछ ।
(४) उपदफा (३) मा जुनसुकै कुरा लेखिएको भए तापनि सूचना अधिकारीले कुनै
व्यक्तिको जीउ–ज्यानको सुरक्षासँग सम्बन्धित सूचना माग गरेको रहेछ भने त्यस्तो सूचना
माग गरेको चौबीस घण्टाभित्र निवेदकलाई उपलब्ध गराउनु पर्नेछ ।
(५) सूचना अधिकारीले निवेदकद्बारा माग भएको सूचना सम्भव भएसम्म माग भएको
स्वरुपमा नै उपलब्ध गराउनु पर्नेछ ।
(६) उपदफा (५) मा जुनसुकै कुरा लेखिएको भए तापनि निवेदकले माग गरेको
स्वरुपमा सूचना उपलब्ध गराउँदा सूचनाको स्रोत बिग्रने, भत्कने वा नष्ट हुने सम्भावना भएमा
सूचना अधिकारीले सोको कारण खोली उपयुक्त स्वरुपमा निवेदकलाई सूचना उपलब्ध
गराउन सक्नेछ ।
(७) कुनै व्यक्तिले उपदफा (१) बमोजिम कुनै लिखत, सामग्री वा काम कारबाहीको
अध्ययन वा अवलोकन गर्नको लागि निवेदन दिएको भए सूचना अधिकारीले निवेदकलाई
त्यस्तो लिखत, सामग्री वा काम कारबाहीको अध्ययन वा अवलोकनको निमित्त मनासिव समय
उपलब्ध गराउनेछ ।

(८) उपदफा (१) बमोजिम प्राप्त भएको निवेदन जाँचबुझ गर्दा निवेदकले माग
गरेको सूचना आफ्नो निकायसँग सम्बन्धित नदेखिएमा सूचना अधिकारीले सो कुराको
जानकारी तुरुन्त निवेदकलाई दिनु पर्नेछ ।

9. उजूरी दिन सक्ने : (१) सूचना अधिकारीले सूचना उपलब्ध नगराएमा, सूचना दिन अस्वीकार
गरेमा, आंशिक रुपमा सूचना उपलब्ध गराएमा वा गलत सूचना दिएमा वा सरोकारवाला
होइन भनी सूचना नदिएमा सम्बन्धित व्यक्तिले त्यसरी सूचना नपाएको वा आंशिक रुपमा
सूचना पाएको मितिले सात दिनभित्र प्रमुख समक्ष उजूरी दिन सक्नेछ ।
(२) उपदफा (१) बमोजिम प्राप्त उजूरी जाँचबुझ गर्दासूचना नदिएको वा आंशिक
रुपमा सूचना दिएको वा गलत सूचना दिएको देखिएमा प्रमुखले निवेदकद्बारा माग भए
बमोजिमको सूचना उपलब्ध गराउन सूचना अधिकारीलाई आदेश दिनेछ र त्यसरी आदेश
भएमा सूचना अधिकारीले सम्बन्धित निवेदकलाई सूचना उपलब्ध गराउनु पर्नेछ ।
(३) उपदफा (२) बमोजिम जाँचबुझ गर्दासूचना अधिकारीले जानी जानी वा
बद्नीयतपूर्वक सूचना नदिएको, सूचना दिन अस्वीकार गरेको वा आंशिक रुपमा सूचना दिएको
वा गलत सूचना दिएको देखिएमा प्रमुखले त्यस्तो सूचना अधिकारीलाई प्रचलित कानून
बमोजिम विभागीय कारबाही गर्नसक्नेछ ।
(४) उपदफा (२) बमोजिम जाँचबुझ गर्दासूचना दिन नमिल्ने देखिएमा प्रमुखले सोही
व्यहोराको निर्णय गरी सोको कारण सहितको जानकारी निवेदकलाई दिनु पर्नेछ ।
